newsitem.title: USA: William H. Sadlier files to go private.
newsitem.headline: William H. Sadlier files to go private.

text.p: William H. Sadlier Inc said Wednesday it woould file with the Securities and Exchange Commission a cetificate of termination of registration with respect to its private stock.

The company, in a statement, cited a rule authorizing a public company with a class of securities held by fewer than 300 people to file with the SEC, relieving the company of periodic information requirements.
